edits.why: line 39 is the one-line source remark 'То-же, что и предыдущая.' set apart in smaller type after the text, the same kind of line as a colophon; it opens no paragraph, so MainZone-Other (what the other types do not cover).

notes.text: The line is indented like a paragraph start; I read it as an end-of-text remark by its content and type size. If the editor reads it as a paragraph, leave band 3 as MainZone-P.
